title: MDR — Master Data Remediation & AI Clean Core
heroHeadline: Controlled SAPUI5 Master Data Intake, AI Bulk Validation & S/4HANA Push
basicIntro: Welcome to MDR! I am Aayam. Let me show you how we eliminate master data duplication and automate Clean Core governance across S/4HANA Business Partners and Materials.

cards.title: Master Data Integrity & Clean Core Governance
cards.botDialogue: Welcome to MDR! Master data errors are the number one cause of failed S/4HANA transactions. MDR provides controlled intake and automated validation before any record reaches core ledgers.
bullets: Fragmented multi-system creation causes duplicate customers, vendors, and materials.
Manual Excel uploads lack real-time schema validation and trigger transactional posting crashes.
Governance approval bottlenecks freeze business partner creation across regional divisions.

cards.title: Enterprise Process Bottlenecks
cards.botDialogue: Notice the core friction points in uncurated master data: unvalidated tax IDs, inconsistent address standards, and missing classification fields that stall order-to-cash pipelines.
bullets: High exception rates in downstream billing and delivery due to missing master attributes.
Lack of centralized audit trails for mass upload approvals.
Heavy manual cleaning cycles before quarterly financial close.

cards.title: Decoupled Clean Core Remediation Architecture
cards.botDialogue: Here is our Clean Core remediation architecture. Staged records reside in a decoupled SAP BTP database with AI deduplication before triggering verified OData/BAPI updates in S/4HANA.

cards.title: Central Master Data Operational Console
cards.botDialogue: Inspecting the live production console. Data stewards can switch dynamically across Business Partner, Customer, and Material catalogs with real-time discrepancy highlighting.

hotspots.label: Entity Catalog Selector
hotspots.tooltip: Dynamic switching between Business Partner, Customer, and Material master entities.

hotspots.label: AI Deduplication Check
hotspots.tooltip: Fuzzy matching and address verification against active S/4HANA records.

hotspots.label: One-Click Governed Approval
hotspots.tooltip: Multi-tier approval release triggering automated BAPI posting into core ERP.

cards.title: 3-Step Governed Lifecycle
cards.botDialogue: The 3-step lifecycle ensures zero bad records reach core ledgers: bulk intake with immediate schema audit, exception correction, and governed approval push.

steps.title: Submit or Select Data
steps.desc: Choose entity catalog and enter single record or upload multi-row Excel template.

steps.title: Validate & Review
steps.desc: Automated deduplication, postal validation, and mandatory field integrity audit.

steps.title: Governed Approval & S/4HANA Push
steps.desc: Approved records posted touchlessly into SAP S/4HANA via Clean Core OData APIs.

cards.title: SAP BTP & Clean Core Topology
cards.botDialogue: Built with SAPUI5 on SAP BTP Cloud Foundry runtime, integrating with S/4HANA via destination service and XSUAA role collections.

cards.title: Quantified Business ROI
cards.botDialogue: Delivering verified operational velocity and audit compliance across global manufacturing and distribution operations.

cards.title: Deployment Readiness & Next Steps
cards.botDialogue: Ready to test MDR in your landscape? Schedule a briefing or test drive with custom master data catalogs in our sandbox.
